name: Horror Clip: Short Horror Story
source:
Horror Clip: A Short Horror Story - A collection of short horror stories in a visual novel game. This game was made for #screamzonejam9 - 2020 and for 5th Anniversary our Studio (July, 1) 

[WARNING]

This game contains disturbing images and scene of explicit violance and gore.

[NOT RECOMMENDED]
For those who have a history of heart attack!

Please use earphone or headset for more experience.


[CREDIT]
Lead Programmer: Tiesna Sulistiana
Artist: Gheralda Citra Prameswari, Srie Indah
Story: Tiesna Sulistiana
BGM: Darren Curtis Music
